set.body: Scope: add JVM FmriDataset.openLna in dataset and JVM FmriDataset.openZarr in dataset-zarr, both returning Either[DatasetError,FmriDataset]; fold native store/archive/lookup/timing failures at the adapter boundary; require LNA SamplingFrame and exact-or-unique internal archive-run selection with no run-zero default; derive Zarr SamplingFrame only from regular manifest timing using an explicit serializable precision policy; attach provenance as a DatasetMetadata value; expose existing ReadLimits in Zarr options without a generic handle/capability type. Acceptance: seconds/milliseconds, zero/nonzero/negative origins, explicit timing, overflow, very short TR, invalid precision, ambiguous LNA runs, external basis, and provenance propagation are tested; synchronous Zarr remains JVM-only and shared refinement laws run on JVM+JS; whole-run LNA fallback remains observable in source provenance/diagnostics; dataset and dataset-zarr platform tests pass.
set.title: Bridge B: LNA and Zarr composers with provenance
